record.headline: Xero raised the list price of all three plans by 7% to 8% and shortened its new-customer promo from 90% off for 6 months to 80% off for 3 months.
record.who: All three plans; the shortened promo applies to new customers.
record.read: A list-price rise on every tier together with a weaker intro offer means new customers pay noticeably more in their first months. Selling auto-reconcile as a paid add-on on the cheapest plan looks like a way to widen the gap between Early and Growing.
record.caveat: Whether existing subscribers are charged the new prices from the same date is not shown in the saved text.
